title: Identifying of immune-associated genes for assessing the obesity-associated risk to the offspring in maternal obesity: A bioinformatics and machine learning.
authors: Shang, Yanxing; Wang, Xueqin; Su, Sixuan; Ji, Feng; Shao, Donghai; Duan, Chengwei; Chen, Tianpeng; Liang, Caixia; Zhang, Dongmei; Lu, Hongjian
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物信息学和机器学习识别母体肥胖后代下丘脑免疫相关基因，虽涉及转录因子-miRNA调控网络，但核心是基因表达与诊断标志物，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Perinatal exposure to maternal obesity predisposes offspring to develop obesity later in life. Immune dysregulation in the hypothalamus, the brain center governing energy homeostasis, is pivotal in obesity development. This study aimed to identify key candidate genes associated with the risk of offspring obesity in maternal obesity. METHODS: We obtained obesity-related datasets from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. GSE135830 comprises gene expression data from the hypothalamus of mouse offspring in a maternal obesity model induced by a high-fat diet model (maternal high-fat diet (mHFD) group and maternal chow (mChow) group), while GSE127056 consists of hypothalamus microarray data from young adult mice with obesity (high-fat diet (HFD) and Chow groups). We identified differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and module genes using Limma and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), conducted functional enrichment analysis, and employed a machine learning algorithm (least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression) to pinpoint candidate hub genes for diagnosing obesity-associated risk in offspring of maternal obesity. We constructed a nomogram receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve to evaluate the diagnostic value. Additionally, we analyzed immune cell infiltration to investigate immune cell dysregulation in maternal obesity. Furthermore, we verified the expression of the candidate hub genes both in vivo and in vitro. RESULTS: The GSE135830 dataset revealed 2868 DEGs between the mHFD offspring and the mChow group and 2627 WGCNA module genes related to maternal obesity. The overlap of DEGs and module genes in the offspring with maternal obesity in GSE135830 primarily enriched in neurodevelopment and immune regulation. In the GSE127056 dataset, 133 DEGs were identified in the hypothalamus of HFD-induced adult obese individuals. A total of 13 genes intersected between the GSE127056 adult obesity DEGs and the GSE135830 maternal obesity module genes that were primarily enriched in neurodevelopment and the immune response. Following machine learning, two candidate hub genes were chosen for nomogram construction. Diagnostic value evaluation by ROC analysis determined Sytl4 and Kncn2 as hub genes for maternal obesity in the offspring. A gene regulatory network with transcription factor-miRNA interactions was established. Dysregulated immune cells were observed in the hypothalamus of offspring with maternal obesity. Expression of Sytl4 and Kncn2 was validated in a mouse model of hypothalamic inflammation and a palmitic acid-stimulated microglial inflammation model. CONCLUSION: Two candidate hub genes (Sytl4 and Kcnc2) were identified and a nomogram was developed to predict obesity risk in offspring with maternal obesity. These findings offer potential diagnostic candidate genes for identifying obesity-associated risks in the offspring of obese mothers.
abstract_zh: 背景：母体肥胖的围产期暴露使后代易在生命后期发生肥胖。下丘脑是调控能量稳态的大脑中枢，其免疫失调在肥胖发展中起关键作用。本研究旨在识别与母体肥胖后代肥胖风险相关的关键候选基因。方法：我们从基因表达综合数据库（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）获取肥胖相关数据集。GSE135830包含高脂饮食诱导的母体肥胖模型（母体高脂饮食（maternal high-fat diet, mHFD）组和母体普通饮食（maternal chow, mChow）组）中后代小鼠下丘脑的基因表达数据，而GSE127056包含肥胖年轻成年小鼠（高脂饮食（high-fat diet, HFD）和普通饮食组）的下丘脑微阵列数据。我们使用Limma和加权基因共表达网络分析（weighted gene co-expression network analysis, WGCNA）识别差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）和模块基因，进行功能富集分析，并采用机器学习算法（最小绝对收缩和选择算子（least absolute shrinkage and selection operator, LASSO）回归）来确定用于诊断母体肥胖后代肥胖相关风险的关键枢纽基因。我们构建了列线图受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）曲线以评估诊断价值。此外，我们分析了免疫细胞浸润以研究母体肥胖中的免疫细胞失调。进一步地，我们在体内和体外验证了候选枢纽基因的表达。结果：GSE135830数据集揭示了mHFD后代与mChow组之间的2868个DEGs，以及2627个与母体肥胖相关的WGCNA模块基因。GSE135830中母体肥胖后代的DEGs和模块基因的重叠部分主要富集于神经发育和免疫调节。在GSE127056数据集中，HFD诱导的成年肥胖个体下丘脑识别出133个DEGs。GSE127056成年肥胖DEGs与GSE135830母体肥胖模块基因之间共有13个基因交集，这些基因主要富集于神经发育和免疫应答。经过机器学习，选择了两个候选枢纽基因用于列线图构建。通过ROC分析评估诊断价值，确定Sytl4和Kncn2为母体肥胖后代的枢纽基因。建立了转录因子-miRNA相互作用的基因调控网络。在母体肥胖后代的下丘脑观察到失调的免疫细胞。Sytl4和Kncn2的表达在下丘脑炎症小鼠模型和棕榈酸刺激的小胶质细胞炎症模型中得到了验证。结论：识别出两个候选枢纽基因（Sytl4和Kcnc2），并开发了列线图以预测母体肥胖后代的肥胖风险。这些发现为识别肥胖母亲后代的肥胖相关风险提供了潜在的诊断候选基因。
